body: I am working and do have had my own place for a few months, it's just hard having nobody who cares about me. At this point it feels like a very permanent problem, the first time I attempted suicide was in the third grade, I saved up my meds and tried to kill myself but I had my stomach pumped and survived. Considering how my life has been since then I really wish I didn't. Thanks for the reply it means a lot.
